question_text: Will any MrBeast video get more than 100 Million views a week after upload?
resolution_criteria:
If MrBeast uploads a video that receives more than 100 Million views seven days after the upload date at 10:00 AM ET, before Jan 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
This market will count the number of views on the seventh day AFTER the upload date. For example, if a video is uploaded on June 15th, then the view count will be checked at 10:00 AM ET seven days AFTER that date, on June 23rd.
